columns.label: Launch fee
columns.desc: What it costs to launch a token, in US dollars.

columns.label: Trade fee (bps)
columns.desc: Fee charged on each trade, in basis points; 1 bps is 0.01%.

columns.label: Creator fee (bps)
columns.desc: Share of each trade paid to the token creator, in basis points.

columns.label: Graduation market cap ($)
columns.desc: Market cap at which a token moves from the launchpad to an open market, in US dollars.

columns.label: Identity check required (KYC)
columns.desc: Yes when you must verify your identity before you can use it.

columns.label: Public API
columns.desc: Yes when it offers a documented public API.

columns.label: Notes
columns.desc: Our editorial notes about this entry.
